nodes.label: About Icon
nodes.description: Circular teal/cyan icon with a stylized italic lowercase letter 'i', representing the universal 'information' or 'about' symbol. Used as the UI icon for the application's About dialog/section in the E-Tipitaka PC application.

nodes.label: Information / About Action
nodes.description: The 'about' or 'information' UI concept — invoking it typically opens an About dialog showing application metadata (version, credits, license, contact).
